title: Air Filtration
description: Explains MERV ratings, HEPA, and activated carbon, then shows how to filter air with your HVAC, a portable HEPA unit, or a DIY box-fan filter. Covers setting up a clean room, when to wear N95 or P100 masks, and reading the Air Quality Index.
shortDescription: MERV, HEPA, and carbon filters, DIY box-fan purifiers, and N95/P100 masks
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
